categories.name: Nature
categories.desc: Woods, fields and the creatures in them. Layer a bed like Forest Birds with a touch of wind, then add crickets or an owl as night falls.

categories.name: Weather
categories.desc: Rain, wind and storms. These sit well under almost any scene: a little rain on the window makes an inn feel warmer.

categories.name: Water
categories.desc: Streams, rivers, shores and the deep. Streams suit travel montages; waves and gulls make a port.

categories.name: Places
categories.desc: Inns, crowds, fires and workshops. Combine Tavern Chatter with a fireplace and a tune from the Music tab.

categories.name: Dungeon & Cave
categories.desc: Drips, drones and the echo of stone. Keep these low under dialogue; raise them when the party listens at a door.

categories.name: Eerie & Magic
categories.desc: Unease, whispers and arcane hums for haunted places, fey glades and the moment before the ambush.

categories.name: Combat
categories.desc: Drums and clamour to drive an encounter. Fire stingers from the Stingers tab on top for hits, roars and spells.

categories.name: Music
categories.desc: Looped tunes under the ambience. Volume these low so the table can still hear you.

categories.name: Stingers
categories.desc: One-shot effects that play once when you fire them: clashes, thunder, bells, doors, roars and spells.
